activity.notes: The surviving privateering patent appoints Amaro Rodríguez Felipe (Amaro Pargo) as a captain of privateers on 14 December 1711 in the service of Philip V. The patent was tied to the vessel Bravo; when he sold Bravo in June 1712, that specific legal authorization ceased.

sources.title: Reconstruyendo el legado de Amaro Pargo — Universidad de La Laguna
sources.citation_text: University of La Laguna research reviews documentary evidence establishing Amaro Pargo's historical activity as a corsair.

sources.title: La Patente de Corso de Amaro Pargo
sources.citation_text: Publishes and discusses the patent dated 14 December 1711 and documents the sale of the patent-linked vessel Bravo in June 1712.
